notes.title: Patch Notes 1.24
notes.notes:
Some more issues were found, including some super niche, but annoying crashes, so we're addressing them with haste.


Fixes
Fixed a potential crash that could happen if you skipped some cutscenes with unique events (like acquiring items)

Fixed a potential crash that could happen when hovering around a unit with no items in their inventory.

Fixed issue where Bow Knight Avatar did not have the proper tags.

Fixed issue where one support chain could still be obtained if one of the units was dead.

Fixed issue where Cleo's Flight Swap targets wouldn't always reset each turn.

Fixed issue where some status effects still used placeholder special effects.

Fixed issue where some character portraits turned into the wrong unit when transformed into Tombstones.

Fixed trigger conditions for skills like Coco's Overexcited. 

Fixed typo in one of Alivar's level up quotes. 

Fixed typo in Leila and Cleo's support.  

Fixed typo in one of Sawyer's promotion description.

Fixed unnecessary popup when claiming Victor's Hero Relic. 

Fixed issue where the wrong song played in one version of Chapter 7's ending. 

Fixed issue where the wrong portrait was highlighted for a message in Ch8's intro.





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.23
notes.notes:
Alright! This should be the final patch for version 1. We will be slowing down the daily-ish updates and work on (free) future content updates, but are dropping a few improvements and a new cursed relic before putting our head down for the new content.


Improvements
Players on Normal mode were typically ending their playthroughs at a lower level compared to Veteran/Madman players due to lower enemy density, so this is an attempt to level the playing field without a difficulty-based experience modifier to keep our battle formulas the same for all players.  

Exp Rubberbanding has been tightened. If a unit is lower level than their target and they deal the finishing blow, they will get a little bit more exp. This has no effect on chip exp or KOs when a unit was higher level than their target.

Chapter 28 has been slightly adjusted on Normal mode- no changes on Veteran or higher.

New Cursed Relic - Wizard Roach - Available in Ch20's Cursed Shop. 


Fixes
Fixed issue where two of Sharif's Level Up Quotes and Voice Lines were inversed. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.22
notes.notes:
We've made a few more fixes and improvements, including fixing the triggers on support achievements!


Improvements
Laetitia's Gunslinger Map Sprite - Bubbles now appears on Laetitia's shoulder in her Gunslinger class as well when waiting to be sent into battle! 

Inanna's Staff effect has been shortened by 1 turn to better reflect the description. 


Fixes
Fixed issue where 3 achievements weren't triggering properly. 

Fixed issue where Nashwa was randomly pushed up in the deploy order during intermissions 3 and 4. 

Fixed issue where Mushroom Nut Coco would disappear after acting.

Fixed issue where Leila's Level Up Text Quotes and Voice lines would sometimes not match.  

Fixed issue where some trees in Chapter 28 did not have the right terrain effects. 

Fixed issue where Nayeli's wolf riding promotion did not have the Beast tag. 

Fixed issue where Nayeli's name would appear to be speaking instead of Keri's for one message in their first support conversation.

Fixed visual error where negative terrain bonuses had "+-" before their modifiers instead of just "-".

Fixed some typos. 



Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.21
notes.notes:
We have heard only good things about the new compression settings from 1.20, which is great news! But we are still monitoring the issue and working on improvements and fixes.


Improvements
Ayka now has the Rogue trait and the Lockpick passive as she was commonly mistaken as a Rogue by players, so we are canonizing it! 

Annabelle's Relic, Hermes's Grasp, now gives exp when used. 

Replaced multiple placeholder skill icons to make them more recognizable. 

Anna, Lilith and Mako now gain B rank in their new weapon types upon promotion to account for their later recruitment and limited time to gain weapon exp.

Erin now gains B rank in her new weapon types when promoting to Superstar. She also gains B rank Primal in her Visionary promotion, but remains C staves in that class.

Increased Weapon Exp gains for Daggers.

Adjusted some Weapon Rank requirements for Daggers. Some were mistakenly E rank, like Killer Daggers.  

Increased Fell Contract's (Thief Avatar's Hero Relic) Stat Bonuses when held from +2 Spd to +5 Dex/Spd.  


Fixes
Fixed issue where Zee would not be affected from Permadeath in Ch29. 

Fixed issue with Movetaker relic that said that the user would gain health, not movement, when defeating an enemy. 

Fixed issue where Victor sometimes had two Rogue tags. 

Fixed issue where Ikan kept his Butterfingers passive even after being recruited. Yay for handkerchiefs! 

Fixed issue between Chapter 27-28 where some characters would stick around in cutscenes where they shouldn't be depending on the order in which supports were viewed. 



Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.20
notes.notes:
Today, we are addressing two major issues that had been lingering for a while. Please do let us know if these issues have been addressed properly this patch!


Improvements
Changed the compression type for many graphical assets to address the Failed To Allocate Graphical Memory issue. Please do let us know if this issue has been improved or not as we will make adjustments if necessary.

Added a sound effect when a Revival Shard is broken to bring some more attention to what just happened.

Updated Runic Seal's description to add the range and cooldown.


Fixes
Fixed issue where Ch17 would require spamming the skip button to get through a black screen.

Fixed issue where some units could crit with a displayed 0% crit due to a rounding error if the crit chance was 0.5%. 

Fixed issue where Leila and Everlast's portraits would remain on screen after one of their supports.

Fixed issue where Durandal's Tip wrongly had a self-heal effect. 

Fixed issue where EMP wrongly had extra Mt when moving before attacking.

Fixed issue where Ayka couldn't use the Rally staff in Ch17. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.19
notes.notes:
Fixing a niche crash as well as some more improvements and fixes.


Improvements
The boss of Chapter 23 now has been standardized with the boss of Chapter 12 with the Aftershock+ skill.

One of the bosses from Chapter 25 has an edited portrait to differentiate them from a similar playable character, making it confusing to read through in their boss conversation. The bosses's names now have an indicator to differentiate them from players as well. 

Increased the duration of the pause between Epilogues. You can still right click to skip each epilogue individually to get through them faster. 


Fixes
Fixed a crash that could happen in niche circumstances through the Combat Arts UI. 

Fixed issue where Chapter 23 boss did not have an indicator for the Moon Blessing passive. Now sparkles in the dark like other dark elves. 

Fixed issue where a gale leaf could disappear in Chapter 8 after defeating Mauve. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.18
notes.notes:
Some slight improvements and small fixes. 


Improvements
Convoy can now contain up to 400 items, up from 250. 

A few bandages were added to late game shops. 

Standardized some descriptions to properly state when they increase Protection versus when they reduce damage taken. 


Fixes
Fixed issue where Aquatic units with Landswim passive still could not access on-map shops. The feud between shopkeepers and squids can be put to rest. 

Fixed typo in Unyielding passive that stated that it reduced Prt instead of increasing it. Has no effect on the skill's effect, merely the description.

Fixed issue where Thanatos did not have the Self Rooting effect from its description.

Fixed visual issue where Mage Avatar and Miles's Group Training support bonuses did not appear on their support pages. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.17
notes.notes:
Some more fixes and improvements across the board.


Improvements
Sheauga's Portrait got some extra shading details. 

Soul Witch Nashwa's Soul Kiss  effect now has 3 range to match supports. 


Fixes
Fixed issue in Ch20's supports where some characters would remain visible on following support conversations.

Fixed issue where Remington's Chick Magnet skill was behaving unpredictably. 

Fixed issue where Asahi's Bad Blood relic didn't redirect poison damage. 

Fixed issue where some enemies had unneeded weapon ranks for weapon types they couldn't use.

Fixed typo in Skilled Scales using Skl instead of Dex.

Fixed issue where Witch Ciara and Wild Mage Sophie did not get Use Leftover Mov. 

Fixed issue where Bow Knight Avatar could Use Leftover Mov, but had no visual indicator for it.

Fixed issue where Eithinoha was E rank instead of S rank.

Fixed issue where Alivar was missing some happy portraits for his good level up quotes. 

Fixed issue where Flynn and Sharif's support points weren't reset after each conversation.

Fixed issue where Earthen Spear could not be traded off of Gryff. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.16
notes.notes:
A quick patch, mostly to fix a weapon rank issue for late game bosses.


Improvements
Main Menu Theme Volume Adjusted - The main menu theme was flagged as being much louder than the other tracks, so we have toned it down a bit. 

Loosened a few support requirements to allow some pairs to be benched a map or two without locking them out of the entire support chain. 




Fixes
Fixed issue where some bosses in Ch28 were unable to use their weapons in some scenarios. 

Fixed a typo in the prologue. 

Fixed Overclocked Combat Art calculations. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.15
notes.notes:
Do not fear, because Jinglesworth is here! 


Improvements
A lot of people brought the Rogue's Heart to the Resurrection Pods in Ch18, which was used for another interaction... So we are making it a thing! 

New Playable Unit : Jinglesworth - Bringing the Rogue's Heart to the Resurrection Pods will allow you to trade it in exchange for an undead thief called Jinglesworth. 

Saviour Annabelle's Healing Around skill has been changed to no longer require a staff use, but now has a cooldown. 

Lilith's squad in Chapter 21 now has a bit more HP to help defend her.

Increased WExp for multiple gauntlet and melee weapons to match other weapon types. 

Anna's First Aid command now gives 8 exp when used. 




Fixes
Fixed issue where Corsair Sophie was missing her Another One! active command.

Fixed issue where a player could own two Hé-no primal tomes.

Fixed issue where the S rank Primal Earth tome Eithinoha wasn't available. 

Fixed issue where Superstar Erin's Light Magic animations could freeze the battle animation.

Fixed issue where Keri had 4 ears in one support conversation.

Fixed issue in Chapter 14 where Zee's death would not trigger a game over. 

Fixed issue in Chapter 15 where the game displayed a turn limit that wasn't taken into account. The turn limit has been removed entirely. 

Fixed issue in Chapter 21 where an enemy thief would act again after using a smoke bomb without having the trickster passive. He now sits patiently for his turn after using a smoke bomb. 

Fixed issue in Chapter 21 where three bikers would target Lilith's squad instead of the player, putting her in more danger than intended.

Fixed issue where Coco's Overexcited passive wouldn't trigger if a Runic Wall was summoned by Miles beforehand. 

Fixed animation issue with Aura gauntlets attacking at range. 

Fixed description on Hunting Rifle.

Fixed issue where Berserker Sigrunn disappeared after acting. 





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.14
notes.notes:
A small update to address a crash and some more improvements!


Improvements
Asahi & Gene Support - If Asahi already used the Villager's Growth scroll when gaining the skill through the Gene support, he will instead be given a scroll so players aren't penalized from using the growth scroll on him early.

Added a Flower in Ch28.

Ikan now gets the Flower Picker skill from his support with Flordeliza. 




Fixes
Fixed issue where Grindstones did not work on status staves such as the Marking Staff. 

Fixed crash in Flordeliza and Ikan's support chain. 

Fixed issue where Lifetaker could sometimes get stuck in a 'triggered' state and wouldn't trigger again on subsequent KOs.





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13
notes.notes:
A long awaited improvement alongside some bugfixes.


Improvements
Reposition Units - Battle Preps now includes a Reposition Units command to disable the battle preps UI and allow you to move units around before the map starts. You can still use the default option to 'cancel' (right click by default) during battle preparation if you were used to it. 

Buffed weapon durability some weapons had very low durability for seemingly no reason, so they were brought up to par with similar weapons of similar power.

Frozen Helmet held item now grants Ice element when held on top of the default effect to remove follow-up restrictions. 

Enemy Draconic Barons now have the skill "Close & Personal" to be more in line with other promoted classes.




Fixes
Some classes should've had access to Use Leftover Mov, but didn't have the skill. These classes were given Use Leftover Mov to patch with their movement type.

Conversely, some classes that had access to Use Leftover Mov, but didn't have the skill showing that they did. These classes were given the visible tag for Use Leftover Mov to match the fact that they could use their leftover mov.

Fixed issue where Blood Mage Astrid in wolf form had access to a Combat Art that she shouldn't have access to, causing her animations to break. This art was removed. 

Fixed issue where Kitoko's Shed Skin would not Shed the Root debuff.

Fixed issue where Diego couldn't use his Spyglass through his Command menu in Chapter 17 (Flynn Version).

Fixed issue where some cliff tiles in Ch16 were flagged as empty tiles.

Fixed typo in Colossus Scroll's description.

Fixed typo in Quetzalcoatl's description.





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.12
notes.notes:
As the game's stability increases, most of the changes today are improvements!


Improvements
Mystique Drain - Asahi's promoted skill now displays the buff's duration in the skill's description.

Energy weapon WExp adjustments - Most energy weapons got an increase in WExp gains. 

New Energy Weapon : Evolution - New A Rank Energy weapon can be found in Ch23's armory and is dropped from an enemy in Ch26. 

Plasma tweak - Plasma is now effective against Bugs and is now a Fire Element weapon.   




Fixes
Fixed issue with Asahi's Hero Relic that led to the wielder to take a lot more recoil damage than intended. 

Fixed issue that allowed players to get two copies of Tidebreaker, the S Rank firearm.





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.11
notes.notes:
Some QoL tweaks and some bugfixes, today!


Improvements
Intermission 2 - Alivar's Mobile Emporeum Stock upgrade! Alivar now sells some Grindstones, Bandages and intermediate weapons during intermission 2. 

The Beetle that spawns near the Mimic in Chapter 6 will now wait patiently for Player Phase before doing so. No more cheating.

Fixed Blade Master Tomoe's Fist Battle Animations to avoid a freeze that would occur instead of battle animations playing out.

Fixed Blade Master and Warrior Monk Tomoe's Map sprites disappearing after acting. 

Fixed issue where one of Asahi and Gene's Romantic Support would result in them sticking around on the next conversation. Get a room, already!

Fixed issue where Nayeli's normal sprite would show up for a message during Chapter 16 (Quidel Vers.)

Fixed issue where Maple's Learned Skills would not display. This fix is only applied to players who have not recruited Maple yet. He will still learn skills normally if the Learned Skills list isn't updated.





Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

Michelle buff : +15 HP, +3 Mag, +2 Spd, +6 Def/Res, +10 Lck.

Staff Expert - S Ranking Staves now grants the Staff Expert skill, giving +5 Lck/Res to the unit. 

Chapter 17 (Keri Vers.) - Ayka now provides a bit more guidance on how to avoid Zuri's Stone Pulse before it triggers, telling her allies to take cover behind cacti and trees.

Combat Arts that give another action after a KO now also states in their description that this can only happen once per turn.




Fixes
Fixed issue that caused Sawyer's Crits to Freeze up his battle animations.

Fixed issue in Save Menu that prioritized mouse's cursor placement even though your mouse was not moving, giving the illusion of a menu freeze. 

Monster Hunter Avatar can now use Firearms as advertised. 

Ayka's Hero Relic, the Moonblight bow, now correctly has the Dark Element tag in its description. 

Fixed portrait display issue in Flynn and Daisie's romantic conversation.  

Fixed some minor typos in some cutscenes.

Added more weapon variety in shops that appear on the map after Chapter 18.

Fixed issue where Mako's relic was unobtainable. 

Fixed issue where Thunderflare Daggers were 1 range instead of 1-2 range as the description would imply.

Fixed issue where Nayeli and Flynn's final platonic support background was on a boat instead of in a cave. 

Fixed a bunch of "Weapon Type" Range+1 descriptions to be clearer.



Thanks again for playing and sharing your experience!

Fixed issue where Daisie's Pixie Heal could buff enemies when using offensive staves. Top 10 anime betrayals.

Fixed issue where an allied unit in Chapter 21 could not use their weapon.

Cursor Improvements - Cursor movement was improved, especially on controller.

Fix / Improvements - Grim Corvus Curtis's Magical Owl used to grant overlapping buffs with Night Owl. Now has been buffed/fixed to give +4 to Str/Mag/Dex/Spd.

Updated Enemy Threat Ranges - These shouldn't lag as much when they display and now properly display enemy threat ranges featuring Pass.

Fixed issue in Chapter 4 where a fairy is flagged as dropping an item, but doesn't.

Fixed issue where Rogue Heart could still be obtained in 100% growth mode.

Fixed issue where the wrong music temporarily played at the start of the final map.

Fixed issue where Sophie and Laetitia's supports crashed after bubbles talked.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6
notes.notes:
Smaller patch including mostly niche interaction fixes.
Fixes
Fix crash that could happen if Anna used First Aid without Healing  Herbs in her inventory.

Fix issue where some characters wouldn't have their growths set to 0% or 100% until another character was recruited in Hardcore or Ideal mode, respectively. 

Fixed issue where Midas Gold Gain and Recoil damage from Fury/Poison Weapons would get stuck and unable to be triggered again. 

Fixed issue where Mako and Captain Laetitia couldn't step on some specific stairs. 

Fixed issue in Ch23's Ending Cutscene that would lead to a crash during Ch24's Support Conversations. 



Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.notes:
A bunch of improvements on the menu today, alongside a freeze that has been a mystery until now!


Improvements
Find Familiar - Your Familiar now spawns next to you on Map Start, like Maple does with Coco. They are immune to permadeath or grievous injury, and they can be dismissed at any time during the map to escape from the chapter. 

Coco's Nut - Giving Coco the Golden Nut now unlocks the Midas's Nut combat art, allowing her to generate gold when defeating enemies with that art. The free levelup is also kept alongside the new effect. 

Sawyer's Bodyguards - Sawyer now gets extra backup if he appears as an ally in Ch9, giving players more time on average to recruit him before he is defeated.

Samira's Dusk Dance - Reworked Samira's Grim Cadence to work as described- a single ally can be refreshed, but nearby enemies do not get their damage buffed.

Firearms Buffs - Firearms that are accessible early got a small increase to their durability and wexp gains to compensate for their rarity and to be more commonly usable throughout the earlier chapters without requiring as many grindstone uses.


Fixes
Fixed a black screen freeze that could happen upon completing a chapter if an ally was grievously wounded while holding a key. This was most commonly found in chapter 8, but has been fixed across the board.

Fixed issue where you could revive dead units by reclassing them with a promotion badge. Leave necromancy-ing to Everlast, please.

Fixed issue where Druid/Beast Stance buffs could be cleansed from Astrid with a Recover Staff. They also have new neat icons to identify them. 

Fixed issue with Ciara's Enchant Cooldown not working as intended. 

Fixed Animation Freeze that could happen on T.Adept Energy crits. 

Fixed Lightning Ploy triggers in chapter 23.

Fixed issue where some water tiles were accessible by foot units in chapter 23.

Fixed issue where a Mercenary from Chapter 17 (Keri vers.) couldn't wield his sword. What a chump.

Fixed issue where Millenia, Kitoko, Gene and Mauve could use Promotion Badges to reclass between their advanced classes.

Fixed issue in Chapter 11-1 where a thief would use his smoke bomb in unpredictable and seemingly random ways. 

Fixed issue in Chapter 10-1 where an enemy would try to warp a dead archer on the watchtower. That's just unprofessional, man... 

Fixed missing Again Staff description.



This was a meaty one! I hope you're enjoying the changes!

Fixed issue where Miles and Gallant would appear in the next conversation after their 3* Conversation. You had your turn already!!

Fixed a typo in Chapter 20 that mistakenly referred to Leo as Dio. Jojos across the world rejoice. 



Enjoy!

Ice Drake Description - Updated the Ice Drake's Skill description to make it more intuitive that you get both the positive and negative parts of the drake while above 50% HP.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
A bit of a faster patch to fix a minor, but pressing issue!


Improvements
Sophie Gold Glitch - Bug turned feature : Using a Midas-type Combat Art near Sophie doubles the amount of gold gained. I guess she truly is that lucky.

Yahya's voice lines adjustment - Yahya just got a new microphone and his critical voice lines got their volume increased to be in line with the other lines.

Compressed a wide variety of assets - A bit of a follow-up to Patch 1.1, but this time, this includes the remaining battle animations that weren't compressed yet as well as every SFX in the game, including spells, miss, buffs, etc.

Fixed a label that said that the Bolt Gauntlets were Ice Element. It was hard to tell...

Fixed issue where Spoiler's map sprite kept idling after acting, even when grayed out.

Fixed issue where Spoiler's portrait would turn into Nayeli's portrait during some level ups. 

Fixed issue where Sawyer and Leila's critical quotes would sometimes be missing. 

Fixed issue where you could get an infinite amount of Von Baron Rings or Crescent Rings by replaying the opening to Chapter 11.



Huge thanks again to everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.notes:
Some more small fixes, tweaks and improvements on the menu, today!


Improvements
Visual Indicator for ''Ploy'' Skills updated - The visual indicator for the cross AOE for skills like Asahi's Tactician's Ploy and Cleo's Air Lines could sometimes hide the visual indicator for attacks and movements. They have been toned down to be less intrusive.


Fixes
Fixed Issue where 2 enemies in Chapter 29 couldn't use Gauntlets as they were missing the Gauntlet Wield passive. 

Fixed issue where some terrain was wrongly flagged as being Empty in Chapter 20 instead of being a Misc Item tile.

Fixed issue where some unit's sprites would become invisible after acting. This issue affected a few advanced classes for Flynn, Laetitia, Miles, Remington and Quidel. We have turned off the malfunctioning cloaking device.

Fixed issue where Keri and Spoiler's 1* Conversation wouldn't trigger correctly in Chapter 19. 



Huge thanks to everyone for submitting bug reports and sharing your experience with the game so far!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.notes:
Since launch, we have been keeping an eye out on potential friction points and bugs affect people's enjoyment with the game and we have been monitoring and fixing issues as they arise.


Here are the first patch notes for Gales of Nayeli.


Improvements
While the meta is still very much being developed and we aren't planning on making big sweeping balance changes, especially this early, a few issues became apparent through feedback. 

Staff WExp adjusted - Most low rank Staves give out a bit more WExp to match the WExp curve of other weapon types. Huzzah for Daisie!

Daggers durability adjusted - Most low rank Daggers have increased weapon durability. Thief Avatar and Keri can finally tone down their Grindstone addiction.


Fixes
So far, there were no major breaking points, but we are still adjusting the game to run smoothly on a wide variety of hardware, which is often accompanied by a "Failed to Allocate Graphical Memory" popup. We have addressed the bigger culprits, but are still monitoring the situation and making improvements as we speak.

Compressed a wide variety of assets (Mostly battle animations) to accommodate lower end graphical cards, reducing the amount of invisible battle animations and crashes related to the issue.

Fixed missing voice lines and battle quotes for some late-game bosses. 

Fixed a typo in the Armor of the Colossus description wrongfully stating that the HP boost was 20 as it should've been 25.

Fixed the VFX that plays when eating fruit or vegetables.

Fixed issue while using the Von Baron Swap command. 

Fixed issue where Remington's death would sometimes not trigger a Gameover in Chapter 3-1 (Sorry, buddy...) 

Fixed issue where Sigrunn's death would sometimes not trigger a Gameover in Chapter 9-1 (Sorry Sigrunn, but you will not die in a blaze of glory just yet)



Huge thanks to everyone who has shared their experience with the game. We appreciate your support and your help in finding and fixing these issues!
